stories.title: A frigid Wednesday morning sets the stage for the return of rain and snow
stories.summary: The daily forecast from Idaho's trusted KTVB First Alert Weather team.

stories.title: Skyway Elementary School holds a precautionary hall check due to nearby police activity
stories.summary: The Caldwell Police Department said there was an incident in the area, and "there is no known threat to the school or its students."

stories.title: Scott Slant: Rasean Jones reaching rarified air
stories.summary: Through the first six games of his career, Rasean Jones had 29 catches for 437 yards and a TD. Pretty good, but we hadn’t seen anything yet.

stories.title: Nampa police shift focus to patrol duties following levy failure, aim to maintain response times
stories.summary: Nampa Police are reallocating officers from specialized units to patrol duties to sustain emergency response times after a levy failed to pass.

stories.title: Idaho Fish and Game commissioner to plead guilty on hunting charges, prompting calls for accountability
stories.summary: Originally charged with seven misdemeanor counts, Brody Harshbarger agreed to enter a guilty plea for two of the criminal charges.

stories.title: WATCH: College of Idaho, NNU collide in Mayors' Cup rematch
stories.summary: The storied Idaho basketball rivalry continues as College of Idaho seeks redemption against Northwest Nazarene in the 2026 Mayors' Cup finale Tuesday night.

stories.title: Idaho faces uncertain winter water outlook despite strong El Niño forecast
stories.summary: Idaho faces an uncertain water future. Experts at the Idaho Fall Water Summit discuss strategies to combat potential droughts and changing climate conditions.

stories.title: Idaho wildlife advocates push to ban hunting of wolf pups and their mothers
stories.summary: A petition presented to the Idaho Fish and Game Commission Tuesday night calls for additional protections for young wolves.

stories.title: Four Timberline football players sue over discipline tied to alleged threats of sexual violence
stories.summary: The students allege school leaders violated their rights when disciplining them over allegedly sending violent and sexual messages directed at a female student.

stories.title: College of Idaho football earns No. 1 overall seed in NAIA playoffs
stories.summary: The Yotes head into the NAIA playoffs as the No. 1 overall seed after completing just the second undefeated regular season in program history since 1920.

stories.title: Boise State star Dylan Riley remains in contention for nation's top running back award
stories.summary: Boise State standout Dylan Riley has been named one of 10 semifinalists for the Doak Walker Award, given annually to the nation's top running back.

stories.title: Section of eastbound I-84 in Oregon reopens following crash
stories.summary: Eastbound I-84 between Ontario and Baker City was closed sometime after 7 a.m. after a multi-vehicle crash. It has reopened as of 12:46 p.m., per the sheriff.
